messages.author: fc4bfa562aaa98a3
messages.subject: Tickmarks inside of y-axis?
parts:
Hey guys,

I've now been using ggplot for over a year and this is the first problem I am confronted to in this  library. For a nicer shape of some of my plots I want to put the tickmarks on the y-axis on the inside of the axis. I found some comments in chats which announced that ggplot is not capable doing this. Is that right?

Do you have a solution for my problem?

Thanks in advance!
Lars

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Tickmarks inside of y-axis?
parts:
This is a job for the theming system. Here is a toy example:

library(ggplot2)
library(grid)

ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = disp, y = mpg)) + geom_point() +
theme(axis.ticks.length = unit(-0.25, "cm"),
axis.ticks.margin = unit(0.5, "cm"))

If you want more control, such as thicker tick marks, larger text,
etc., then consult
http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/theme.html

Dennis
